title: Messages not disappearing
body:
### Bug Description

Signal OSX v5.3.0 is not deleting disappearing messages in a group chat

### Steps to Reproduce

setup group with 1 day disappearing but messages in the OSX app are not deleting even though they are on my iPhone.

Actual Result:

messages exist indefinitely it seems

Expected Result:

messages older than 24 hours should disappear

### Screenshots


![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/240811/119769567-8790e780-be6f-11eb-9779-d56ee86246aa.png)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/240811/119769610-99728a80-be6f-11eb-83d9-705c9045cb41.png)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/240811/119769626-a1322f00-be6f-11eb-80cb-be94408da22f.png)

### Platform Info

Signal Version: OSX v5.3.0

Operating System: OSX 11.2.1 (20D74)

Linked Device Version:

iOS 5.12.0.51

comments.author: Participant 9
comments.body: Hey folks this is fixed in v5.5.0 and we'll be shipping a beta release today with the fix as well.

comments.author: Participant 10
comments.body:
All: Please try to get as detailed as you can to describe the situations you're still seeing in 5.5.0 (production) and 5.6.0-beta.1. We made changes to improve this, but perhaps you're still seeing issues?

If you are, please tell us which messages are not disappearing, or how far off their timers are. When did you get these messages, etc.? And finally, always, please include your debug log and the 'sent id' of the disappearing message(s) in question (the 'sent id' is the number next to the sent header on the message details screen).

comments.author: Participant 6
comments.body: Have you been unable to replicate it on any current version of Signal for macOS over the past month, which is how long it's been happening? As for how far off the timers are, once the timer fails, the message apparently lives forever. When a thread is affected by this, it seemingly affects all messages in that thread. About 40% of my conversations/threads are affected on two versions of macOS, including the latest, Big Sur. These are all one-on-one conversations, in my case.

comments.author: Participant 10
comments.body: @joe940 We do expect to release a change that will fix old messages, but at this point we'd like to focus on whether any new messages are having problems. Are messages being sent and received with the most recent version of the app having problems?

comments.author: Participant 6
comments.body: This is still happening, though in fewer threads than before. It may or may not be the case that it is more likely to happen if the desktop app hasn't been opened for two or three days. The timer is visible but just never moves, and the affected messages live on.

comments.author: Participant 11
comments.body:
@joe940 Could you try opening all affected conversations and seeing if the problem persists? We've written some logic to clean those up in general, but we do further cleanup when you open a conversation.

If it's still an issue, I'd love to do some more detailed debugging with you. Please email evanhahn@signal.org and we can work through it.
